mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points triggers market anxiety about economic deterioration, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) below 95 and 520 respectively indicate broad-based economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days due to demand destruction.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 95 and HOUST < 520.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized rate > 3.0%) signals imminent monetary tightening, reducing equity risk appetite and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL inflation rate > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 6 months reflects strong consumer spending momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days via earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) falling below 130,000 thousand signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending capacity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS < 130000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real sales (RSAFS) below 370,000 million and federal funds rate increase above 0.2% indicates policy tightening amid weakening demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS < 370000 and FEDFUNDS > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate earnings visibility and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 90.
